outcome: Cognitive performance (Verbal IQ, Performance IQ, Full Scale IQ)
cohort: The study included 101 adults born very premature and/or at very low birth weight (<32 weeks of gestation and/or birth weight <1500 g) and 109 full-term control subjects, all assessed at 26 years of age.
finding: Prematurely born adults showed altered gray matter T1w/T2w ratio, with higher ratios in widespread cortical and subcortical areas and lower ratios in the superior temporal gyrus, where lower T1w/T2w ratio was associated with lower full scale and verbal IQ.
